UXO & EOD Support

UXO & EOD Support.

Specialist support for unexploded ordnance (UXO) and explosive ordnance disposal (EOD) requirements, with the involvement of relevant authorities.

Service scope

How we can help.

  • UXO search and clearance
  • Underwater UXO clearance
  • Battle area clearance involving relevant authorities
  • Bomb threat consultancy through our consultancy service

Our team brings naval clearance diving and EOD experience. We establish the scope, responsibilities and relevant authority involvement for each engagement.

Useful answers

Your questions, answered.

What do UXO and EOD mean?+

UXO means unexploded ordnance. EOD means explosive ordnance disposal. Contact our team to discuss specialist support for your project.

Does clearance work involve the authorities?+

Clearance work involves coordination with the relevant authorities. Contact the team to discuss the project scope and coordination requirements.

Based in Seri Manjung, Perak. For project enquiries around Manjung, Lumut, Sitiawan or another location, see our local enquiry information and tell us where the work is needed.
